description: Replace public dashboard placeholder (app/(public)/index.tsx) with polished live dashboard using FEAT-001 components. Display: HeroEnergyCard showing dailyEnergy from getDashboardMetrics (PUBLIC endpoint, no auth), and 4 MetricCards in vertical column showing voltage/current/power/energy from getRecentReadings(1) (PUBLIC endpoint, no auth). Implement pull-to-refresh, loading states, error states with retry, empty state when no readings exist. Responsive layout: stacked vertical on mobile. Use React Native ScrollView with RefreshControl for pull-to-refresh. Handle safe areas properly. This is the primary public-facing dashboard accessible without login.
steps: Read existing app/(public)/index.tsx to understand current structure and navigation patterns
Replace app/(public)/index.tsx content completely - remove placeholder card and Phase 1 notices
Import useDashboardData and useRecentReading hooks from FEAT-001
Import HeroEnergyCard, MetricCard, ErrorCard from FEAT-001 dashboard components
Import React Native components: ScrollView, RefreshControl, View, Text, StyleSheet, ActivityIndicator
Implement component state: combine loading/error states from both hooks to determine overall screen state
Implement pull-to-refresh using RefreshControl component - calls both refetch functions, shows refreshing spinner

Layout structure: ScrollView wrapper with RefreshControl > SafeAreaView > vertical container with 16px gap > HeroEnergyCard (full width) > 4 MetricCards stacked vertically (Voltage, Current, Power, Energy from reading.energy field). Each card full width with 16px bottom margin.

Display logic: if both hooks loading initially, show loading skeletons. If either has error, show ErrorCard with combined retry function. If metrics exist but no reading, show HeroEnergyCard with metrics and MetricCards with null values (display '--'). If both loaded successfully, display all data. Empty state: when totalReadings is 0, show message 'No sensor data available yet' in a card.
MetricCard for Voltage: label='Voltage', value=reading?.voltage, unit='V', precision=1, color='blue'
MetricCard for Current: label='Current', value=reading?.current, unit='A', precision=2, color='amber'
MetricCard for Power: label='Power', value=reading?.power, unit='W', precision=1, color='green'

MetricCard for Energy: label='Energy (Latest)', value=reading?.energy, unit='kWh', precision=3, color='green' - this is the cumulative energy from the latest reading, distinct from dailyEnergy in hero card

Styling: background #F5F7FA, 16px horizontal padding, proper safe area handling using SafeAreaView with edges=['top', 'bottom']. Cards have consistent spacing. Typography: title 24px bold #0A2947, subtitle 16px #64748B.
Preserve navigation to existing public screens (analytics, energy) if those buttons exist - otherwise remove them as they are placeholders

Add timestamp display under hero card showing lastReadingAt from metrics, formatted as relative time (e.g., 'Updated 2 minutes ago') or 'Never' if null. Use simple date formatting - no external libraries.
acceptance_criteria: app/(public)/index.tsx displays live dashboard with HeroEnergyCard and 4 MetricCards
Dashboard loads data from getDashboardMetrics() and getRecentReadings(1) using hooks from FEAT-001
Pull-to-refresh works - swipe down refreshes both datasets and shows spinner
Loading state shows skeleton cards on initial load
Error state shows ErrorCard with retry button that refetches both datasets
Empty state (no readings) shows clear message when totalReadings is 0
Null values display as '--' in MetricCards, distinctly from zero which displays '0.0' or '0.00'
Dashboard is accessible without authentication (public route)
Layout is responsive and works on small screens (320px width minimum)
Safe areas are handled properly (no content under notch/home indicator)
Timestamp shows when data was last updated
npm run type-check passes with 0 errors after implementation
verification: Run 'cd mobile && npm run type-check' and confirm 0 TypeScript errors
Start Expo dev server with 'cd mobile && npm start' and open on device/simulator
Verify dashboard displays without authentication (public route)
Pull down to trigger refresh and verify both datasets reload
With backend running, verify dashboard shows live data (energy, voltage, current, power)
With backend stopped, verify error state displays with retry button
With no readings in database, verify empty state message displays
Test on smallest screen size to verify layout doesn't break
